# UISet docs

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.mjs from the registry. Edit that script, not this file. -->

UISet is themes, components, kits and templates for Vercel's UI SDK. Every item installs with the shadcn CLI and is styled by the skin around it.

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @uiset/uiset
```

## Kits and parts

| Item | What it is | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `uiset` | The UISet root: skins, a key color, and sound and haptics for every UI SDK component inside it. | [Root](./theming.md) |
| `app-shell` | A sidebar layout that collapses to icons with Mod+B, remembers it, and becomes a drawer on narrow screens; with sidebar navigation. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `breadcrumbs` | Where you are, with the current page marked. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `page-header` | A page title with description and actions. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `card` | A bordered block with header, title, description, content and footer. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `badge` | A short status label in five tones, readable in every skin, and a count badge for the corner of an icon or avatar. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `stat` | A number with its change, said in words as well as color, and an optional trend sparkline. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `empty-state` | What to do when there's nothing here yet. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `skeleton` | Loading placeholders, and a Loading region that announces once. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `description-list` | Terms and their details. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `item-list` | Rows with media, title, description, meta and actions. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `alert` | An inline message in four tones that names its tone, interrupts only when urgent, and can be dismissed. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `kbd` | Keys written the way this platform writes them. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `spinner` | A loading indicator that says what's loading. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `stepper` | Steps of a flow with the current one marked and later ones locked. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `search-field` | A search box with a clear button and a key that focuses it from anywhere. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `copy-button` | Copies a value and says so. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `table` | A plain HTML table in a scroll area: sticky headings, a sticky first column, and rows that stack into labelled blocks on narrow screens. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `avatar-group` | Avatars stacked in a row, with a count of the ones that don't fit. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `code-block` | Code in its language's colors with a file name, line numbers, marked lines and a copy button; tabs for versions of the same code; and one command for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun that remembers the choice. | [App frame and data display](./app-shell.md) |
| `schema-form` | A form from one definition: its fields with UISet's controls, steps with a review, checks as people type and on submit, and an agent that fills it by field name while a person approves the submit. The same definition is JSON Schema for an agent tool. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `inline-edit` | Text you edit where it shows: press it, Enter or F2 to edit, Enter to save, Escape to cancel, with validation and optional Save and Cancel buttons. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `tag-input` | Tags people type, paste or pick: a comma or Enter adds one, a pasted list becomes one tag each, and Enter or F2 edits a tag in place. No duplicates, a limit, your own rules with the reason shown, and agents add and remove tags by name. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `phone-input` | A phone number with a country picker: formatted as it's typed with the caret kept in place, a typed calling code chooses the country, any script's digits, left to right on any page, and the value in E.164. Agents set the number in any format and the country by name. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `input-mask` | Fields formatted as they're typed with the caret kept in place: card numbers grouped by brand with the brand named, expiry dates and security codes, IBANs checked by country and checksum, amounts grouped in the locale, and patterns of your own. Each checks itself and reports its value without separators; agents set them in any format. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `upload` | A drop zone and a queue of uploads on UI SDK's File input: each file's preview, progress and status, with cancel, retry and remove, a few going up at a time, to whatever storage you use. | [Forms](./forms.md) |
| `sortable-list` | A list people put in order: drag an item by its grip, or pick it up with Space and move it with the arrows. Select several to move together, lock items in place, and let agents move items by name. | [Lists and trees](./lists.md) |
| `sortable-tree` | A tree people reorder and nest: drag a row up or down and sideways to change its level, or pick it up with Space and use the arrows. Only branches hold items, a drop elsewhere goes back and says why, and agents move items into branches by name. | [Lists and trees](./lists.md) |
| `payments` | How to pay and what it pays for: payment methods as cards to choose from, card fields whose security code follows the brand, a bank account by IBAN with its mandate, an order summary with a discount code and totals in the shop's currency, and a Pay button an agent can't press without a person. | [Payments](./payments.md) |
| `address` | An address whose fields follow its country: the order it writes them in, its names for them (ZIP code, Eircode, Prefecture), the ones it requires, a list of regions where it has one, and its postal code's shape, from Google's address data for 252 countries. Autofill fills it; an agent fills it in one step by field name. | [Address](./address.md) |
| `number-ticker` | A number that moves to its new value, each skin its own way: Base rolls its digits, Blueprint counts, Studio steps, Phosphor types it, Ink redraws. It can count up once when first seen. People and agents read the value itself. | [Motion](./motion.md) |
| `text-reveal` | Text that arrives a word or a letter at a time, each skin its own way, and reveals only what's new as a streamed answer grows. The whole text is in the page from the start, for screen readers and agents. | [Motion](./motion.md) |
| `thinking` | A wait, each skin its own way: words that shimmer, moving hatching, an LED chase, printing dots, or still dots. A status, so screen readers hear it once. | [Motion](./motion.md) |
| `crossfade` | Content swapped in place, each skin its own way, while the box moves to the new content's size. The leaving content can't be reached or read. | [Motion](./motion.md) |
| `rich-text` | A rich text editor on UI SDK with no editor library: headings, nested and numbered lists, to-dos, quotes, code, links, mentions, dividers and images; a toolbar, Markdown as you type, "/" for blocks and "@" for people (TriggerMenu); safe paste from documents and the web; undo; Markdown and clean HTML out; agents read and write Markdown. | [Rich text](./rich-text.md) |
| `chat` | A conversation built on UI SDK: thread that follows new messages, messages with avatars, actions and versions, suggestions, plans and a thinking shimmer. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `chat-response` | Streaming markdown that repairs itself mid-stream and never renders raw HTML, with code blocks highlighted by skin colors. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `chat-parts` | Reasoning that opens while the model thinks, tool calls with status, input and output and Allow or Deny when one waits for approval, subagent runs with their own steps, checkpoints to restore, sources, citations and images. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `chat-message-parts` | Draws a Vercel AI SDK message's parts with the chat kit: Markdown text that completes while it streams, reasoning, tool calls in every state with approvals, sources, files, a plan, checkpoints and subagent runs. No dependency on the ai package. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `chat-composer` | The message box: Enter to send, history with ArrowUp, slash commands and mentions, attachments by drop, paste or picker, a model picker, a usage meter, and the messages queued while the agent works. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `chat-sidebar` | A list of chats with rename and confirmed delete, and a floating assistant launcher. | [Chat](./chat.md) |
| `data-grid` | A spreadsheet-grade grid on UI SDK: virtualized rows, sorting, filters, grouping, pinned, resizable and movable columns, row and cell selection, inline editing with validation, clipboard copy and paste, CSV export, a saved layout and agent actions. | [Data grid](./data-grid.md) |
| `chart` | The frame every UISet chart shares: title, a legend that isolates series, a Chart/Table switch with the table twin, a keyboard listbox of data positions, tooltips, palettes validated for color blindness per skin, and agent actions. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `line-chart` | Trends over time: one or more lines, a soft area for one series, or stacked areas, with a crosshair that lists every series and labels at line ends. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `bar-chart` | Categories compared: columns or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked, ranked, with thin marks and values at the tips. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `scatter-chart` | Two measures per item, up to three groups, with hover that finds the nearest point. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `heatmap` | Magnitude on a grid in one hue, with a scale and arrows that move by cell and by row. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `segmented-bar` | One whole split into up to six parts, with shares printed where they fit: the readable answer to a donut. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `sparkline` | A trend inside text, a table cell or a stat, whose name says where the values went. Works in Server Components. | [Charts](./charts.md) |
| `board` | A kanban board on UI SDK createTransfer: one tab stop, arrows across cards and columns, Space to carry a card, drag with the pointer, column limits, add in place, a details dialog to edit, move or delete, filters, and agent actions. | [Board](./board.md) |
| `scheduler` | Calendars on UI SDK createSpans: a week, a day or a room timeline where people draw, move and resize events with the pointer or arrows, overlapping events sharing lanes, a month view, a toolbar, an event dialog, and agent actions. | [Scheduler](./scheduler.md) |
| `canvas` | A node editor on UI SDK's canvas behaviors: pan and zoom, drag nodes or move them with Alt and arrows, spatial focus, Shift-drag box selection, wires drawn by pointer or with C and arrows, a minimap, zoom controls, a toolbar, an inspector, undo, and agent actions. | [Canvas](./canvas.md) |
| `ide` | A code editor's parts on UI SDK: a file tree on Tree with version control marks, New, Rename, Move and Delete, and files dragged into folders; editor tabs on Tabs; a code editor with syntax colors, indenting and problems; a command palette on Command; problems and a status bar. | [IDE](./ide.md) |
| `mobile` | Phone app parts on UI SDK: rows that swipe aside to actions (createSwipeActions), wheel pickers and a time wheel (bindScrollPicker), bottom sheets and action sheets (Drawer), pull to refresh, an app bar and a tab bar. | [Mobile](./mobile.md) |
| `terminal` | A terminal on UI SDK's input history and stick-to-bottom: ANSI colors kept readable in every skin, links, streaming commands with progress lines, Tab completion, Ctrl+C and Ctrl+L, built-in help, clear and history, and agent actions. | [Terminal](./terminal.md) |
| `knob` | A rotary control built as a UI SDK primitive: drag, arrow keys, log scales, double-click reset, agent actions. | [Studio](./studio-kit.md) |
| `patch-bay` | Jacks and cables built on UI SDK createConnect: patch by drag, keyboard or agent. | [Studio](./studio-kit.md) |
| `fader` | A vertical UI SDK slider with its label and readout. | [Studio](./studio-kit.md) |
| `level-meter` | A UI SDK meter drawn as an LED ladder. | [Studio](./studio-kit.md) |
| `step-sequencer` | A row of steps built on UI SDK ToggleGroup, with downbeats and a playhead. | [Studio](./studio-kit.md) |
| `agent-console` | The human side of the UI SDK agent bridge: approvals in your app, an activity feed with undo, highlights where the agent changed something, a thread and a prompt. | [Agent Console](./agent-console.md) |
| `agent-check` | Checks whether an agent can use a page: every control named, each name finding one control, and none that only looks clickable, with a score. Through a UI SDK app's agent bridge, or by reading any site's accessibility tree. In a test (expectAgentReady, expectPageReady), on a page in Playwright, from the command line, or drawn over the page (showAgentReadiness). | [Agent readiness](./agent-check.md) |

## UI SDK components

Each of UI SDK's 55 components as its own item, styled by the skin, with UISet's defaults. Their API, parts and keys are UI SDK's: the linked page applies as it is.

| Item | What UISet adds | API and keys |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `button` | A button in solid, outline and ghost variants, and one that asks for a second press. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/button) |
| `switch` | An on and off switch, with its thumb in place. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/switch) |
| `slider` | A range slider whose track, fill and named thumbs render in one line. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/slider) |
| `segmented-control` | One choice among a few, in a row with a moving indicator. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/segmented-control) |
| `select` | Choose from a list in a popup; the trigger shows what's chosen. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/select) |
| `field` | A label, control, description and error, connected for screen readers. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/field) |
| `dialog` | A modal window for a focused task, closed by Escape or its close button. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/dialog) |
| `tabs` | Panels that share one space, switched by a row of tabs. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/tabs) |
| `accordion` | Sections that open one or many at a time. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/accordion) |
| `alert-dialog` | A confirmation that interrupts, with agent confirmation built in. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/alert-dialog) |
| `autocomplete` | Free text with suggestions as you type. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/autocomplete) |
| `avatar` | A person's image with initials as the fallback. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/avatar) |
| `calendar` | A month grid for picking dates, ready to use as is. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/calendar) |
| `carousel` | Slides with previous and next controls and keyboard paging. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/carousel) |
| `checkbox` | A checkbox with its check mark, and checkbox groups. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/checkbox) |
| `collapsible` | One section that shows and hides. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/collapsible) |
| `color-picker` | Area, hue and alpha sliders, swatch and hex input, ready to use. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/color-picker) |
| `combobox` | Search a list and choose one or several. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/combobox) |
| `command` | A searchable list of commands, for palettes and launchers. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/command) |
| `date-input` | A date typed segment by segment, in the reader's locale. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/date-input) |
| `date-picker` | A date field with a calendar popup. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/date-picker) |
| `drawer` | A panel that slides in from an edge. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/drawer) |
| `file-input` | Choose, drop or paste files, with validation. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/file-input) |
| `hover-card` | A preview that opens on hover or focus. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/hover-card) |
| `image-cropper` | Crop, zoom, rotate and flip an image. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/image-cropper) |
| `input` | A text field, with clear button and groups. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/input) |
| `label` | A label for any control. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/label) |
| `listbox` | An always-visible list to choose from. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/listbox) |
| `menu` | Actions from a button or a right click, with submenus. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/menu) |
| `menubar` | An application menu bar. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/menubar) |
| `meter` | A measurement within a range, as a bar or a ring. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/meter) |
| `navigation-menu` | Site navigation with panels. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/navigation-menu) |
| `number-input` | A number field with named step buttons, ready to use. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/number-input) |
| `otp-input` | A one-time code field with a slot per character. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/otp-input) |
| `pagination` | Page links with named previous and next, ready to use. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/pagination) |
| `password-input` | A password field with a show toggle. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/password-input) |
| `popover` | A panel beside its trigger. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/popover) |
| `preferences` | User preferences applied as data attributes and saved. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/preferences) |
| `progress` | Progress of a task, as a bar or a ring. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/progress) |
| `radio` | Radio groups with their dot, and cards that choose an option wherever you press. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/radio) |
| `rating` | A star rating, ready to use. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/rating) |
| `resizable` | Panels you resize by dragging or with the keyboard. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/resizable) |
| `scroll-area` | Styled scrolling, plus ScrollBox with the parts in place. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/scroll-area) |
| `separator` | A line between content. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/separator) |
| `textarea` | Multi-line text that can grow with its content, and a count of its limit. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/textarea) |
| `time-input` | A time typed segment by segment. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/time-input) |
| `timeline` | Events in order, with markers and a connecting line. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/timeline) |
| `toast` | Notifications, with a Toaster ready to render once. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/toast) |
| `toggle` | Pressed buttons and toggle groups. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/toggle) |
| `token-input` | Text mixed with tokens for files, people or tags. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/token-input) |
| `toolbar` | Buttons and toggles with one tab stop. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/toolbar) |
| `tooltip` | A short hint on hover or focus. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/tooltip) |
| `tree` | A hierarchy you expand and select. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/tree) |
| `trigger-menu` | Suggestions after @, / or # in a text field. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/trigger-menu) |
| `waterfall` | Spans on a time axis, like request timings or a trace. | [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev/docs/components/waterfall) |

## Templates

| Item | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `auth` | Sign in, sign up, forgot and reset password, and verify a code: native validation, server messages, autocomplete hints and a password strength meter. |
| `dashboard` | A date range that scopes everything: figures with trends, revenue, orders by channel, plan mix and recent orders. |
| `settings` | Profile, security and sessions, notifications, billing with usage and invoices, team with invites and removal, and a danger zone. |
| `admin` | A records list with search, filters, columns and export; create and edit in a drawer; inline edits; confirmed bulk delete; an empty state. |
| `inbox` | Mail in three panes: folders, a message list you arrow through, the message with star, archive and delete, and compose. |
| `chat-app` | The chat kit as a product: chats, a thread and a composer, with your model plugged in as an async stream of events. |
| `ide-app` | A code editor in resizable panes: files with version control marks, tabs, an editor with syntax colors, a command palette (files, commands, lines), problems, an outline and a status bar. |
| `project-board` | A project's issues as a board or a list: sprint progress, search and an assignee filter, column limits, card details, a new-issue form and Undo on moves. |
| `calendar-app` | A calendar app: day, week and month views, a small month to jump to a day, calendars to show or hide, what's next, and events created, edited and deleted in a dialog. |
| `checkout` | A checkout: contact, a delivery address whose fields follow its country, delivery options, card or bank payment with a billing address when it differs, and the order with a discount code and Pay beside it. Pay checks the whole page and focuses the first problem; an agent fills it and a person pays. |
| `invoice` | An invoice: who it's from and to (each address as its country writes it), its dates and status, the lines with tax and total in its currency, how to pay by bank transfer with the IBAN and reference to copy, and notes. It prints clean. |
| `pricing` | Plans with a monthly or yearly switch, a recommended plan, a comparison table and questions. |

See [Templates](./templates.md) for each one's props and sample data.
